subject: german
title: Brecht and Epic Theatre
welcome_lead: Brecht's epische Theater alienates the audience to encourage critical thought. Mutter Courage is a touchstone.
meta_desc: IBDP German HL Literature: Brecht, epic theatre, Verfremdung.
final_note: Brecht wants you to think, not to feel.

concepts.def: Alienation effect — disrupting illusion to provoke thought.
Mother Courage and Her Children (1939), Brecht's anti-war drama.

walkthroughs.body_html: Brecht breaks the fourth wall, uses placards, songs, and direct address. The audience never forgets it is watching theatre.
Anna Fierling profits from the Thirty Years' War selling supplies — and loses her three children to it. The contradiction is Brecht's lesson.
Written in 1939 in Swedish exile, as Brecht fled the Nazis. The Thirty Years' War (1618-1648) is allegory for contemporary war.
